kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تشرذمت (form IIq)
# تَشَرْذَمْتُ (tašarḏamtu) /ta.ʃar.ðam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَشَرْذَمَ (tašarḏama)
# تَشَرْذَمْتَ (tašarḏamta) /ta.ʃar.ðam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَشَرْذَمَ (tašarḏama)
# تَشَرْذَمْتِ (tašarḏamti) /ta.ʃar.ðam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَشَرْذَمَ (tašarḏama)
# تَشَرْذَمَتْ (tašarḏamat) /ta.ʃar.ða.mat/: t
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
